shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band of repeated pattern crossing the surface
dense field of small repeated incised marks (scale-like or hatched texture)
object with a curved handle over a rectangular body (bucket-like shape)
raised rectangular framing edge / panel border
justification: The most specific correspondence is the bucket-like handled shape (held in the figure's hand in A, repeated as three abstract forms along the top of B) together with a horizontal band of repeated pattern and areas of dense scale-like hatching, both worked in shallow relief on stone. Against this, A is a single tall naturalistic human-bodied figure with modelled musculature filling one framed panel, while B is a schematic, blocky multi-register composition of animals and abstract signs on an irregular pillar, so the arrangement and carving manner are essentially unrelated.
